newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa quiet as many Europeans on holiday.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa quiet as many Europeans on holiday.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa opened up in line with opening calls, then traded in a tight range in thin volume.
A holiday in much of the European continent means that many market players are away from their desks today, traders said.
"There's nothing going on at all," one trader said. "A lot of people aren't in. It's just a waste of time."
"Cocoa was just trading light volumes in a tight range," he said.
By the midday break, active July was four sterling higher at 1,020 sterling, on volume of 347 lots. Total volume by the break was 585 lots.
